Intruders have entered our world, "Nun"!
Anyone who spots their hiding place must report it immediately!
m920201.同じ道を歩めるのなら、協力すべき。\n――と、王子が言って譲らなかったので。:
If we can walk the same path, we should cooperate.
That was the Prince's stance, and he refused to budge.
m920201.和平を結ぶと決めたのなら、\n強引にでもそれを推し進めるしかない。\nそうしない: If we have decided to make peace, we must push it forward, by force if necessary. Otherwise, those sparks will only multiply without end.
m920201.嘘に嘘を積み重ねた結果にゃ。\nでも、まだ負けてはいにゃい。\n連中を倒してしま:
This is the result of piling lie upon lie.
But we haven't lost yet.
If we defeat them, no one will know the truth.
m920201.報告ご苦労にゃ。\n陣形はこのまま、太陽神殿を死守するにゃ。:
Good work on the report, my cat.
Hold your formation and defend the Sun Temple to the death, my cat.
m920201.太陽神様は、己が命と引き換えに、\n物質界の砂漠に太陽を取り戻したのにゃ。\nだ: The Sun God sacrificed his own life to restore the sun to the deserts of the material world, nya. That is why he no longer exists in this world, nya.
m920201.太陽神殿があるというなら、肝心の太陽神は？: If there's a Sun Temple, where is the Sun God himself?
m920201.契約の代償であった黄金も、\nもはや十分な量が供出されている。\nここから先は、:
The gold, which was the price of the contract, has already been paid in sufficient quantity.
From here on, it is up to them to decide their own fate.
m920201.女神アイギス、女神アダマスの神器、\n亜神トラムの輝きの剣、太陽神イルドナの応報:
The divine artifacts of Goddess Aigis and Goddess Adamas,
the Radiant Sword of Demi-God Tram, the Sword of Retribution of Sun God Ildana...
And from the All-Father of Asgard――
m920201.女神アイギスに永遠の命を貰ったからな、\nそう簡単に、性格まで変わりはしないさ。:
Since Goddess Aigis granted me eternal life,
my personality isn't exactly going to change overnight.
m920201.安寧の世界を望むと告げ、余に恭順を誓いながらも、\n彼らの魂には繁栄と生を望む意:
They told me they desired a peaceful world and swore their allegiance to me,
yet deep within their souls, they harbored a desire for prosperity and life.
m920201.容易に想像がつきますよ。\nかつては神の庇護下にあり、今は亜神ディアスの庇護下。:
It's easy to imagine why.
They were once under the protection of a god, and now they're under the Demigod Dias.
Their individual strength is considerable, but they lack real combat experience.
m920201.寝起きで運動とか、身体に悪いですよ？: Exercise right after waking up? That's bad for your body, you know.
m920201.待って、あの祭壇にあるのは……。\nまさかドラウプニルの腕輪！？:
Wait, what's on that altar is...
Could that be the Draupnir armlet?!
m920201.待つにゃ、あの腕輪は、\n戦乱の時代の砂漠を救った礼に、\nある獣人の女王から献: Hold on, nya, that armlet was a gift presented by a certain beastkin queen, in gratitude for saving the desert during the era of chaos, and――
m920201.怒る姿も可憐だな、アンブローズ。\nおぉよしよし、可愛いなぁ。:
Even when you're angry, you're adorable, Ambrose.
There, there. So cute.
m920201.悩んでも始まらにゃい、か。\nここを通すわけにはいかない、それにゃら、\nあいつ:
Worrying won't change anything, I suppose.
I can't let them pass, so I'll have to smash every last one of them, my cat.
m920201.悪だくみは終わったか？\nさぁ太陽と黄金に祝福されし民たちよ、\n不届き者どもを:
Are we done scheming?
Come, blessed people of the Sun and Gold!
Let us crush these insolent upstarts!
--- scene: Olympus Fourth Layer (battle, end) ---
m920201.惰弱な発想です……。\nアスガルドの民なら、\nきっとそんな壊死した世界は望みま:
What a lazy way of thinking…….
If the people of Asgard were here, they would surely never wish for such a rotting world.
m920201.憐れまないでくれますかぁ！？\nこれから成長しなおすんですからねぇ！:
Please don't look at me with that pitying expression!
I'm going to grow back to my proper size, you know!
m920201.懺悔をするにも、祈りを捧げるにも、\n本人がいるのなら本人の前ですればいいのです:
Whether you wish to confess your sins or offer your prayers,
it is best done in the presence of the one you address.
m920201.我らには太陽と黄金の加護がある！\nくくっ……連中を追い込むぞ！:
We have the protection of the Sun and Gold!
Heh... let's corner them!
m920201.我ら真なる太陽神の眷属と、\nその敬虔なる民の手で、\n貴様の大げさな伝説を終わ:
By the hands of us, the true kin of the Sun God,
and his devout people,
we shall put an end to your grandiose legend!
m920201.戦というものは、国同士、元首同士だけでなく、\n民の間まで、いくつもの火種と軋轢: War breeds not only conflict between nations and their leaders, but countless sparks of tension and friction among the people as well.
m920201.故郷ではないが、故郷に近い場所。\nなんとも不思議な感覚だな。:
It is not my homeland, but it is close to it.
What a strange sensation.
m920201.数で勝るからこそ、だ。\n連中の練度は高い。下手に追撃すれば、\n戦線が伸び切っ:
That is precisely why.
Their training is superior. If we pursue carelessly,
our lines will stretch too thin, and we'll be picked off one by one.
m920201.来るにゃら来ーい！！\nぶちのめしてやるにゃー！！:
Come at me then!!
I'll smash you to pieces, my cat!!
m920201.正確には設計者、くらいでしょうか。\nこの後に向かう第四層が砂漠の国の原型である: "Designer" would be more accurate, I suppose. Just as the Fourth Layer we're heading to is the prototype of the Desert Kingdom, Kunlun was the place that became the prototype of the Flower Kingdom.
m920201.民とて勝利に飢えているさ。\n何しろこいつは侵入者、永遠の安寧を約束された、\n:
The people are hungry for victory, too.
After all, this intruder has stepped into the Fourth Layer, "Nun,"
a land promised eternal peace, a plunderer!
m920201.民のために、同胞のために命まで燃やした。\n彼女は立派な戦士にして、王です。:
She burned her life for the people and her comrades.
She is a fine warrior, and a king.
m920201.民を守るために嘘をついていた。\nそれも、民も、神も、世界も騙す嘘を。\n太陽神:
They lied to protect the people.
Even a lie that deceived the people, the gods, and the world itself.
They concealed the very absence of the Sun God.
m920201.民を守る意志があり、そのために剣をとることができる。\n志を同じくする方々を処刑:
Those who have the will to protect their people and the ability to take up the sword for that cause……
There is no need to execute those who share the same ideals, is there?
m920201.永遠の安寧、変化のない世界、\n大きな幸福もない代わりに、\n誰も苦しまない場所: There are those who seek a place of eternal peace, a world without change. No great happiness, perhaps, but no suffering, either.
m920201.滅びを許容できぬなら、それは神ではない。\n矜持と生き様、それを守るためなら、\:
If one cannot accept destruction, one is not a god.
For the sake of their pride and the way they live,
they will choose to accept their own destruction.
m920201.無限の「黄金」を供出し続けることで、\nその庇護下に入っているんだ。: By offering up an endless supply of "gold," they have placed themselves under his protection.
m920201.物質界の砂漠は、太陽神様にとってみれば、\n我が子のような存在だ。愛し子が飢えて: To the Sun God, the deserts of the material world are like children. He could not have stood by and watched his beloved offspring starve.
m920201.特に、君らがヒュープの守る第一層を超えた直後から、\n太陽神殿の警備が過剰に強化:
Specifically, the moment you passed through the First Layer guarded by Huip,
the security around the Sun Temple was reinforced to an excessive degree.
m920201.王国は「ヌン」の民に対して、協力を惜しみません。\nヒュープ様、元始天尊様、ハリ:
The Kingdom will spare no effort in cooperating with the people of "Nun."
Hyp, Yuanshitian, and Haringheim have all agreed to support this initiative as well.
m920201.王子、聞いてのとおりです。\nあの亜神たちには\n不用意に兵を近付けさせないのが:
Prince, as you can see,
it would be wise not to bring our troops too close to those Demigods.
m920201.王子、黄金の魔力を消し飛ばす！\nあとはお前の指揮に任せたぞ。:
Prince, I'll obliterate the golden magic!
The rest is up to your command.
--- scene: The Radiance of Draupnir (battle, end) ---
m920201.王子ちゃん、このちんまい可愛い子は、\n一緒に千年戦争を戦った徐華ちゃんで――: Prince, this tiny, adorable girl is Xuhua. She fought alongside us in the Millennium War—
m920201.王子殿、兵士諸君、あの猫神像が見えるか？\nあれには可能な限り触れないように気を:
Your Highness, soldiers, can you see that statue of the cat deity?
Try not to touch it if you can help it.
If you accidentally attack it, things are going to get complicated.
m920201.王子殿は、お嬢さんたちを裁くつもりはないぞ。\nそうだろう？: Your Highness has no intention of judging you, girls. Correct?
m920201.生きるための知恵だと思ってあげよう。\n誰もが王子殿のように、\n自由意志こそ重: Let's call it the wisdom of survival. Not everyone thinks that free will is what matters most, the way Your Highness does.
m920201.目を離すとふらふら前線に出ていく最高司令官に、\n実力は確かだけどぽやぽやな司令:
I had to keep a close eye on the Supreme Commander, who would wander off to the front lines the moment I looked away,
and the competent but scatterbrained Commander,
and finally, this reliable but suffocating person. It was quite something.
m920201.砂漠の国の、バステト教団の者たちに会ってあげてください。\n長い歴史の波の中で教:
Please meet with the members of the Bastet Cult in the desert nation.
It is said that over the long waves of history, their doctrine became distorted and their traditions scattered――
m920201.砂漠の神は、この「ヌン」にいました。\n大いなる太陽神、戦神ゼクメト、\n豊穣の:
The gods of the desert were here, in this "Nun."
The Great Sun God, the War God Zekmet,
the Bountiful Bastet――no, Bastis... perhaps.
m920201.神々を殺しうる槍、グングニル。\n無限の富を生み出す腕輪、ドラウプニルが。:
Gungnir, the spear that can slay gods.
And Draupnir, the armlet that generates infinite wealth.
m920201.神なる右目、我が父の力を！\n今、我が身を捧げ――:
Divine Right Eye, the power of my father!
Now, I offer my body—
m920201.神殿を守ることだけが、目的ではない……？: Defending the temple isn't their only objective……?
m920201.私たちのッ！ 勝ちですッ！\nドラウプニルの腕輪を返しなさい！！:
We won!
Return the Draupnir armlet!!
m920201.私たちの信仰とは何だったのか、\n父祖の伝承が、子孫たる私たちに嘘を伝えていたの:
What was our faith, really?
Did the legends of our ancestors lie to us, their descendants?
m920201.私は、赦すつもりはありませんが。: I have no intention of forgiving, however.
m920201.私はこれまで、イルドナと協力し、\n第四層から上層へと続く経路を探していた。\n:
Up until now, I have been working with Ildna
to find a path from the Fourth Layer to the upper levels.
However, progress has been… difficult.
m920201.空を覆い尽くす暗黒の霧は、\nあたしたちの主神、偉大なる太陽神の力を弱め、\n民:
The dark mist that covered the sky
weakened the power of our lord, the great sun god,
and stole the will to live and the daily sustenance of the people, nya……
m920201.第四層「ヌン」の民への食料支援に、\n雇用確保に、訓練環境の提供じゃと？: Food aid for the people of the Fourth Layer, "Nun"…… securing employment, and providing a training environment, is it?
m920201.第四層「ヌン」は偉大なる太陽神に導かれし、\n繁栄と光の都だと聞いていましたが…:
I heard that the Fourth Layer, "Nun," is a city of prosperity and light,
guided by the great sun god……
Where is that sun god now?
m920201.管理者の元始天尊が好き勝手しておるのだ、\n儂が付いていったって良いじゃろ？:
The administrator, Yuanshi Tianzun, is doing whatever he pleases, you know.
I can come along without any trouble, can't I?
m920201.聞け王子、ドラウプニルの契約を半分奪った。\nこれから黄金の魔力を打ち消していく:
Listen, Prince. I've seized half of the Draupnir contract.
From here, I'll nullify the golden magic.
m920201.華の国の大地が、第二層「崑崙」をモデルとしたように、\n砂漠の国の大地は第四層「:
Just as the land of the Flower Country was modeled on the Second Layer, "Kunlun,"
the land of the Desert Country has been heavily influenced by the Fourth Layer, "Nun."
m920201.見逃すものか。\nこの第四層にいる限り、\nすべての民の目が、我らの目だ。:
Let them go?
As long as we remain in this Fourth Layer,
the eyes of every citizen are our eyes.
m920201.覚悟を決めた顔した小娘の、\n足を引っ張るとか、儂の趣味じゃないからのう！:
Tripping up a young lady who has made up her mind...
That's not really my style, you see!
--- scene: Faith in the Cat God ---
m920201.調子に乗るとぎっくり腰やりますよ？: If you push yourself too hard, you'll pull a muscle.
m920201.諦めるな。\n我が父は命を燃やし、太陽を取り戻した。\n民のために、砂漠のために:
Do not give up.
My father burned his life to reclaim the sun.
For the sake of the people, for the sake of the desert, we must not yield.
m920201.謝るなんて、あなたらしくないですよ。\nでも、ありがとうございます。:
Apologizing is not like you at all.
But... thank you.
m920201.負け猫根性が染み付いているのか、お前は。\n見苦しい……まるで命乞いのような語り:
Has the spine of a defeated cat seeped into you, you fool?
Disgusting…… your words sounded nothing like a plea for mercy……
m920201.足場を作ってやる。\nこいつを、略奪者を殺せッ！！:
I'll give you a foothold.
Kill this one, the plunderer!!
m920201.蹴散らしてやりましょう。\n今はなんだか、暴れたい気分です。\n私は後方の敵をい:
Let's trample them.
I feel like causing some trouble right now.
I'll take the enemies in the rear.
m920201.連中、民に嘘をついてるからなァ。\n死ぬ気で太陽神殿を防衛するんだろうな。:
They're lying to their people, you know.
They're going to defend the Sun Temple with their lives.
m920201.階層移動直後に遭遇したのは不運だったけど、\nそうでなくても、間違いなく敵対され:
It was bad luck that we ran into them right after the layer transition,
but even if we hadn't, we would have been treated as enemies
and ended up in the same situation.
m920201.隠れたがっているのに、それを教えるとか無粋じゃろ。\nそれに……。:
When someone is trying to hide, telling them that would be rather rude, wouldn't it?
Besides...
m920201.黄金は……もうないけど、\n捧げられるものはすべて、王国に捧げるにゃ。: The gold is……gone, but we will offer everything we have left to the Kingdom, nya.
m920201.（いつまで、偽りの神話を、\nこの階層は続けていけるのかにゃ……）:
(How much longer can this layer sustain
such a false myth...?)
--- scene: City of Hot Sand (battle, start) ---
m920201.（偽物だって、作りものだって、\nぜーんぶ守りとおして、幸せがっぽがっぽにゃ）:
(Even if it's fake, even if it's an illusion,
I'll protect it all and scoop up all that happiness, my cat.)

m920236.――あっ、マータンさんが戻ってきました。\nでも、何だか落ち込んでいるような……:
――Ah, Martan is back.
But he seems a bit dejected…
m920236.――うぅん、一歩進んだと思うよ。: ――Hmm, I think we've made progress, actually.
m920236.――うおぉぉぉぉぉッ！！\nよく来た挑戦者よ！ 白き獣の戦士よ！！:
—Ooooooh!!
Welcome, challenger! Warrior of the White Beast!!
m920236.――えーっと……。\n一箇所だけのつもりだったのに、\nあちこち回ってもらって…:
――Um…
I only meant to visit one place,
but you took me all over the place… um…
m920236.――おつかれさまでーす。\n物資補給でーす。\nあっ、今日の受付担当はフラフィー:
――Thanks for your hard work.
This is your supply resupply.
Ah, so Fluffy's the one on reception duty today.
m920236.――さて、というわけで、\n王国の里と、北の大国の里、\n雪枝の里の、友誼の儀式:
――Well, with that,
the friendship ceremony between the kingdom's village,
the great northern nation's village,
and the Snowbranch village is complete.
m920236.――ただし、ついてこられる者だけだ！\nさぁ行くぞ！ マータンダッシュ！！:
――But only those who can keep up!
Let's go! Martan Dash!!
m920236.――というわけで、詳しく教えていただけますか？: ――So, could you tell us everything in detail?
m920236.――み、みんな！ 話を聞いて！\nこの人たちは悪い人じゃないから！:
――Everyone! Please listen!
These people aren't the bad guys!
m920236.――もうひとつ朗報です。\nここに里が築かれた理由が分かりましたよ。:
――I have another piece of good news.
We've figured out why this village was built here.
m920236.――グオァァァァァッグ！！\n野郎ども、牙を剥け、咆哮を上げろ！！:
Beastman Knight?: ――GRRRAAAAGH!!
You scum, bare your fangs and roar!!
m920236.――フラフィーさん！ ポワワさん！\n急いで安全なところに隠れてください！！:
Northern Great Nation Knight: ――Fluffy! Powawa!
Get to safety, quickly!!
m920236.――何とも美味だった……。\n場所が違えば食が変わるものだが、\n北限……いや、:
――How delicious…
The food changes depending on where you are, but
the northernmost lands… no, the Interstice Snowfield is full of fine cuisine too.
m920236.――王子！ 侵入者です！\n敵は所属不明の獣人複数！\n警備兵を打ち倒した手練れ:
――Prince! We have intruders!
They're a group of unidentified beastfolk!
They're skilled fighters who've taken down our guards!
m920236.……あたしはまだまだ、半人前だよ。\nでも、なんだか、ちょっと良いなって思ったか:
……I'm still a long way from being a full-fledged guardian.
But, I guess I did feel a little good about it.
m920236.……いえ、こちらの\n行軍速度を上げる方が良いかもしれません。: ……No, I think it would be better if we increased our marching speed.
m920236.……うー。\nたまになら、ね。たまになら！:
……Ugh.
Once in a while, maybe. Just once in a while!
m920236.……えーっと、魔物ではない、と？: Northern Great Nation Knight: ……So, you're not a monster, huh?
m920236.……そうだ！\nねぇ、あんたたち、狭間の雪原を調べてるんでしょ？:
……That's it!
Hey, you guys are investigating the Snowfield Between, right?
m920236.……ただの遭難で済めばいいが。\nこの先は、少々厄介だぞ。:
……If it's just getting lost, that would be a mercy.
Things are a bit troublesome ahead.
m920236.……ついてこい。\nお前たちが悪いやつじゃないのは分かった。\nでも、マータンひ:
...Follow me.
I've realized you're not bad people.
But this isn't a decision Martan can make alone.
m920236.……どうにも、気が急いてしまうな。\n手がかりが掴めそうなのに、いつも一歩届かな:
……I'm getting impatient.
It feels so close, yet I'm always one step too late.
m920236.……もしかして、\nファオルってマータンより交渉つよつよか？:
……Could it be that
Faul is better at negotiation than Martan?
m920236.……マータンったら。\n利き手じゃない方で武器を持ってたら、\nあたしたちに肩入:
……Oh, Martan.
If you're holding your weapon in your non-dominant hand,
it's obvious you're holding back for us.
m920236.……事実だが、言い過ぎじゃないか？: ……It's the truth, but isn't that a bit harsh?
m920236.……今はまだ、\n対話のできる余地があると思ってる。: ...I believe there is still room for dialogue.
m920236.……急ごう。\n魔力の乱れに釣られて、魔物も集まってきた！:
……Let's hurry.
The magical disturbance is drawing monsters in!
m920236.……王子の許可が出れば、ですが、\n落ち着いたらもっと別の場所にも行きましょうか:
……If the Prince gives his permission, of course,
we could head to other places once things settle down.
m920236.……説得、上手くいくでしょうか。: ……Do you think the persuasion will go well?
m920236.……里の外に出ると、\n人さらいに誘拐されるって聞いたから。:
??? : ……I heard that if you leave the village,
kidnappers will snatch you.
m920236.……驚いたね。\nあいつらが気に入るなんて、\n里ではよほど修行を積んできたとみ:
……I'm a little surprised.
For them to take a liking to you so easily…
It seems you've put in quite a bit of training back in your village.
m920236.ああ……確かに、白い毛並みだからって、\n人さらいに狙われる事件は少なくないです:
Ah…… It's true that incidents where white-furred beastfolk
are targeted by kidnappers aren't exactly rare……
m920236.ああ、丁寧にあれこれ話すより、\n南の人たちの目的を端的に伝えて、\n敵対してな:
Ah, so instead of politely explaining everything,
you'll just concisely convey our purpose from the South
and make sure they know we're not hostile?
m920236.あたしが知ってる、「狭間の雪原」の情報だけど――: Here's what I know about the "Snowfield Between"――
m920236.あたしのいた村。\n「狭間の雪原」にいくつかある、\n小さい集落のひとつだよ。:
The village I lived in.
It's one of the small settlements located in the "Snowfield Between."
